description:
## Problem
`.claude/skills/blog/` is listed in skill-sync.conf and in the committed `.claude/skills/skill-sync.manifest`, but `.gitignore` (line 207, `/.claude/skills/blog/`) ignores it and scripts/check_untracked_skill_mirrors.sh forbids tracking it. Each checkout therefore keeps whatever copy was last applied there. In the primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox the six blog files date from 2026-10-01 and do not match the pinned catalog (7625613): `tools/skill-sync verify` reports 6 problems ('content does not match the manifest') and `tools/skill-sync check` lists them as modified. Claude sessions opened in the primary clone load this stale blog skill (it predates the catalog fix in skill-sync-skills 637664d/cd7df4b about project voice guides).

The report added by BenchBox #4306 (`check_primary_clone_clean.sh report`) compares only `.agents/skills/skill-sync.receipt` revisions with skill-sync.conf, so it does not see this. `make skill-sync` cannot refresh it in the primary clone, because the target runs `agent-write-preflight`, which refuses there; on 2026-11-17 the .agents copy was refreshed with a hand-built config that excluded the .claude target, which left the blog copy untouched.

## Evidence
2026-11-18, primary clone at 9899e6cf70: `ls -la .claude/skills/blog` shows 2026-10-01 mtimes; `shasum -a 256 .claude/skills/blog/SKILL.md` = db0a04fa..., manifest entry = 0b7fb7e4... (equal to catalog 7625613:skills/blog/SKILL.md). `git status --ignored` lists it as ignored.

## Decision gate (owner)
Whether the copy may hold local edits is unknown; agents must not overwrite or delete it without approval. Choose and record in context:
(a) Extend the #4306 report to verify ignored mirror paths under `.claude/skills` against the committed manifest and print the refresh command; the owner refreshes by hand.
(b) As (a), and authorise an agent to refresh the primary clone's ignored blog copy once now (backing up the current files under ~/.cache first).
(c) Stop ignoring `.claude/skills/blog` and track it like the other mirrors (reverses the deliberate untracked rule; update check_untracked_skill_mirrors.sh and make/quality.mk skill-sync-check together).
(d) Remove blog from the .claude target in skill-sync.conf.

## Guardrails
- The primary clone stays read-only for agents; any write there needs the owner's choice (b) quoted in context.
- Do not delete or overwrite the existing ignored copy without a backup and approval.
- Do not hand-edit mirror files; changes go through the catalog and tools/skill-sync.
- Keep the CI 'apply then verify then check' step green; it applies the blog copy in a fresh checkout and must continue to pass.
- Related: blog-skill-site-paths-20261017 (the blog skill's content), primary-clone-agents-skills-materialization-stale-20261115 (done, .agents receipt check).

## Verification rubric
Pass only if the owner's choice is recorded; under (a)/(b) a test runs the report against a fixture primary clone with a stale ignored blog file and asserts a warning naming the path and the command, and with a matching copy asserts no warning; under (b) `tools/skill-sync verify` in the primary clone reports 0 problems afterwards and the backup path is recorded; under (c)/(d) check_untracked_skill_mirrors.sh, skill-sync-check and the CI mirror step all pass on the PR. Fail if the report can stay silent while verify reports problems for a mirrored path.
